# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. 

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] New tool/resource added
- [ ] Broken link fixed
- [ ] Duplicate entry removed
- [ ] Category correction
- [ ] HTTP → HTTPS link update
- [ ] Formatting improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist
Before submitting this PR, please confirm:
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] The URL uses HTTPS (not HTTP)
- [ ] This tool/resource is not already in the list (no duplicates)
- [ ] The entry follows the correct format: `* [Tool Name](https://url) - Description`
- [ ] The entry is placed in the appropriate category
- [ ] For new tools: I have verified the tool is actively maintained
- [ ] For link fixes: I have tested the new URL

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the pull request here.

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots to demonstrate the change if relevant.
